question: Name a sublimable substance that can be converted into gas without passing through any intermediate liquid phase.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1) Naphthalene**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Naphthalene** is a common sublimable substance that can convert directly from solid to gas without passing through an intermediate liquid phase.
 
• This property is utilized in mothballs, where naphthalene sublimes to repel moths and other insects.
 
• Other examples of sublimable substances include iodine and dry ice (solid carbon dioxide).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sublimation** is a phase transition that occurs at specific conditions of temperature and pressure.
 
• It is an **endothermic process** where a substance absorbs heat to change its state.
 
• Sublimation is used in various industrial processes, such as freeze-drying and purification of substances.
 
• Understanding the properties of sublimable substances is crucial in applications like air fresheners and chemical synthesis.
